- Cost target: goal to keep incremental unit cost under our benchmark (we’ll quantify after POC)
- Data: PHI-sensitive pipelines; data residency must remain in US; minimal data retention preferred
- Use case: real-time triage + summarization for clinician workflows

- Security/Privacy: Emily Zhou (security) — please loop in if I’ve missed anyone

- NDA in place before exchanging sample PHI datasets
- DPA required (standard RTT + breach notification) — likely requested during procurement
- MSA: redline after successful POC; we expect MSA negotiation to follow DPA/NDA

1) Redwood sends NDA stub to Sonia/procurement by EOD Monday (attached: Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf)
2) Procurement provides procurement POC and any procurement template or special clauses by Wed, 6/23
